segments.title: Lethal Company Gaming Hiatus
segments.notes: Anchor Case Blackwell suspends the news grind for an impromptu cooperative session of Lethal Company with a crew of freelancers, navigating scrap quotas, brackens, bees, and a looming giant while fielding chat via teleprompter.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors an unscheduled gaming hiatus, coordinating a Lethal Company crew while promising a return to the news grind tomorrow.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Mentioned off-mic at stream end as advising Case he could stay longer, but Case departs for a work obligation regardless.

lore_notes.fact: Confirms the broadcast is a one-day break from the regular news grind; will resume news format tomorrow. [51:25]
Departs early for a 'work thing' outside the network, raiding Fiona's channel on exit. [1:03:50]

episode_summary: Barely Informed News suspends regular programming as anchor Case Blackwell leads a Lethal Company salvage crew through eclipsed moons, bracken encounters, and bee hive heists. The anchor confirms the gaming sortie is a single-night hiatus before returning to the news grind, then signs off early for an external work obligation.
